stance_rationale: Hard constraints and the walk-forward weights schedule mostly pass, but several optimizer-gate claims remain unverified: direct daily CVaR/MDD, RF-A1 confidence-aware sizing, PG2 Sequential Admission, beta drift, liquidity evidence, and task-level covariance artifacts.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: Selected highest reported net_ir among 10 candidates; selected candidate also passes reported turnover and CVaR proxy caps.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: 80/20 design is stated, but blended SR/MDD/IR and PG2 TDC are deferred to Forge.

critical_concerns.description: RF-O8 is not closed because the selected CVaR pass uses a monthly-return sqrt(21) daily proxy of 0.0244, only 0.0006 below the 0.025 cap, without direct daily selected-weight CVaR/MDD/stress verification.
RF-O11 remains unresolved: inherited alpha RF-A1 subperiod stability failure is not converted into confidence-aware MVO, BL-prior shrinkage, or explicit use of confidence_vector in sizing.
No optimizer_challenge_note.md was found, and open questions are deferred to Forge, so Charter No Silent Override and process honesty are incomplete.
Sequential Admission is not demonstrated: TDC vs PG2 is null/TBD, and the 80/20 integration scenario lacks blended SR, MDD, and IR.
Required WT-D20260426_005 covariance artifacts are missing from both requested stage paths; only inherited WT_D20260425_010 covariance passes PSD and cond checks.
RF-O4 constraint sensitivity is not reported despite binding upper-weight and max-names constraints; no bound-relaxed concentration test is supplied.
Beta drift audit is absent: beta_port vs benchmark, target-band compliance, and overlay-OFF vs blended beta are not reported.
Liquidity compliance cannot be independently verified from the package because no per-name 20d TV evidence is provided, while the base mandate requires 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW.

supporting_arguments: RF-O5/RF-O6/RF-O7/RF-O13 pass on weights.csv: 213 dates, 10-20 risk names, max risk weight 0.20, min risk weight 0.001217, max sum error about 2.0e-15, and turnover 4.7154 < 6.0.
RF-O9 is not triggered: weights.csv has as_of_date, ticker, weight, method_selected and spans 2006-01-01 to 2023-12-01.
Cost is internally consistent with 15bps one-way round-trip turnover.
Risk inherited Hill alpha is 2.7257, so RF-O12 heavy-tail MVO-alone trigger is not directly active; HRP/InvVol alternatives were also compared.
unresolved_disputes: Whether monthly-to-daily sqrt(21) CVaR is acceptable evidence for a daily CVaR hard cap in KR tails.
Whether CASH at 0.30 is formally exempt from the [0, 0.20] per-name weight bound.
Whether missing WT-D20260426_005 covariance artifacts can be replaced by inherited WT_D20260425_010 covariance for this optimizer audit.
Whether PG2 TDC < 0.30 and blended 80/20 SR/MDD/IR will pass before admission.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that cvar95_daily_proxy=0.0244, derived from monthly returns via sqrt(21), proves the selected daily walk-forward portfolio satisfies CVaR and MDD gates.
rebuttal_required: Produce direct daily selected-portfolio returns with exact weights, cash, regime switches, and costs; report daily CVaR95, MDD, and stress windows.
Add optimizer_challenge_note.md with open_questions for Forge/Judge/Governor.
Show a confidence-aware sizing or BL-prior shrinkage ablation using confidence_vector.
Compute TDC vs PG2 active book and 80/20 blended SR/MDD/IR.
Provide task-level covariance artifacts or a per-sig_date Sigma PSD/condition audit proving cond <= 100 post-shrink.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: This is stronger than a single-snapshot optimizer, but AX-008 cannot pass while daily tail risk, PG2 admission, optimizer challenge notes, beta drift, liquidity evidence, and task covariance artifacts remain unresolved.

optimizer_specific_questions: 이 weights를 22년 시계열에 적용 가능한가? RF-O9는 낮지만 Forge handoff_note가 없다.
method_shopping에서 net_IR 1위가 direct daily CVaR-adjusted 기준에서도 1위인가?
RF-O8 CVaR cap은 월간 sqrt(21) proxy가 아니라 daily selected-weight path로도 통과하는가?
Sequential Admission vs PG2 active book TDC가 portfolio time-series 기준으로 <0.30인가?
